messages:
mia - design: sharing the latest rotate modal mock — can we quick-check the accessibility and microcopy? https://figma.com/file/abcd1234

devon - eng: saw it, nice. main concern: the red banner only has 2.7:1 contrast over the white card? that fails AA for text. recommend darker red or white text. :warning:

sam - ux: agree on contrast. also the banner language sounds alarming: ‘Immediate key rotation will break running services’. Maybe soften to ‘Rotation may cause brief service interruptions for clients using the old key’ and add a link to docs.

lucy - product: flagging an edge-case — for org admins we auto-notify active service owners. Do we have copy for that notification? Should the modal surface who will be notified?

mia - design: good point. current mock has a small line: ‘Active service owners will be notified.’ Should we make that a secondary link to the notification settings?

sam - ux: yes. make it a link that opens notification preview. Also add a visible countdown option — user can choose to schedule rotation in 10m/1h/24h.

devon - eng: backend supports scheduled rotation but: if scheduled, we need to show a deterministic rollback window. UI must state the UTC timestamp and timezone. people miss timezone a lot.

jen-pm: +1 on explicit timezone. Also, what about the undo affordance? we discussed temporary grace period where old key works for X minutes. Copy needs to call that out.

mia - design: mock currently shows an ‘Undo window: 15 minutes’ pill. But are we confident about 15? ops-bot, any hard SLOs here?

ops-bot: config:rotation.undo_window default=900s (15m). Team can change per org in enterprise settings. Audit logs will note rotation and undo events.

sam - ux: then copy should read: ‘Old key will continue to work for 15 minutes after rotation unless your org has a custom undo window.’ Keep it short.

lucy - product: permission flow — we show the ‘Rotate’ button to members with key.manage scope. Could we add a tooltip saying ‘Requires key.manage permission’ and a link to request access? Saves a ticket.

devon - eng: tooltip OK. implement as aria-describedby so screen readers get the reason. Also keyboard focus order: modal header -> reason input -> schedule dropdown -> rotate -> cancel. current prototype had rotate before schedule which is bad.

mia - design: thanks, will reorder. another accessibility nit: success toast uses aria-live=polite but it’s not announced in VoiceOver testing because content is visually inserted in the DOM after the modal closes. Need to ensure live region exists early and is populated later.

sam - ux: good catch. also consider using a confirmation dialog pattern with role=alertdialog for destructive actions. Rotation is dangerous if user confuses with revoke.

lucy - product: can we clarify differences in copy between Rotate vs Revoke? Users often think rotation deletes old key permanently. Maybe two-line description under title: Rotate = issue new key & grace window. Revoke = immediately invalidate.

mia - design: will add that microcopy. keeping the CTA colors distinct helps too (rotate = primary/blue, revoke = danger/red).

jen-pm: empty state for keys page — after revoking last key we show ‘No active keys’ with CTA ‘Create key’. UX research found users appreciate a short checklist: “Who can access keys, rotation policy, audit logs”. Can we surface that?

sam - ux: love the checklist. keep it collapsed by default. present a one-click ‘Set rotation policy’ quick action that opens the scheduling modal prefilled.

devon - eng: tiny dev ask: include a JSON snippet in the modal docs for API-driven rotation so platform devs can wire it up quickly. Something like:

```
POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate
{
  "schedule_at": "2026-03-25T15:00:00Z",
  "notify": true
}
```

mia - design: will add a small chevron link to ‘API example’ that expands that snippet.

lucy - product: copy tweak proposal for confirmation CTA: instead of ‘Rotate’ use ‘Rotate key now’ when immediate, and ‘Schedule rotation’ when delayed. reduces ambiguity.

sam - ux: +1. Also, add a final inline verification: show a list of recent clients that used the key (last 5) so the user can decide if rotation is safe.

devon - eng: we can list last 5 client IDs but not full IPs for privacy. ok to show client names if available.

mia - design: mock will include a collapsible ‘Recent usage’ section. Final ask: can we run a quick colorblind check on the banner color? I’ll push an update today.

jen-pm: timeline — need copy and accessibility adjustments by EOD for next dev sprint. if anyone has blocking objections speak now.

sam - ux: no blockers from UX side. I’ll follow up with wording suggestions in a separate thread.

devon - eng: no blockers from infra, just confirm timezone text and aria-live fix.

mia - design: thanks all — I’ll iterate and upload v2. :heart!
